# appgatesdp_ztp_settings (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_discovery` (Attributes) Settings for Application Discovery integration. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--application_discovery))
- `optimizer` (Attributes) Settings for Optimizer integration. Supported in API versions: v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--optimizer))
- `risk_engine` (Attributes) Settings for Risk Engine integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risk_engine))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--application_discovery"></a>
### Nested Schema for `application_discovery`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Application Discovery integration is enabled or not.


<a id="nestedatt--optimizer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `optimizer`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Optimizer features are enabled or not.


<a id="nestedatt--risk_engine"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risk_engine`

Optional:

- `dynamic_alerts` (Boolean) Whether the receive dynamic risk alerts from Risk Engine or not. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Risk Engine integration is enabled or not.
- `fallback_values` (Attributes) Configure fallback risk values when certain scenarios occur. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risk_engine--fallback_values))

<a id="nestedatt--risk_engine--fallback_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risk_engine.fallback_values`

Optional:

- `device_info_not_available` (Number) Fallback risk value when the Risk Engine cannot find the information for the device. 1 - LOW, 2 - MEDIUM, 3 - HIGH
- `rule_not_working` (Number) Fallback risk value when the relevant rule or adapter is not working. 1 - LOW, 2 - MEDIUM, 3 - HIGH
- `ztp_unreachable` (Number) Fallback risk value when Controller cannot reach ZTP services. 1 - LOW, 2 - MEDIUM, 3 - HIGH
